main_text.head: CAPITVM.
main_text.l: XV. De Ecclesijs Eois alijs, vt conueniant cum Reformatis, & de eorum cum Ecclesia Romana consensu, Epistola Abrahami Ecchellensis ad Leonem Allatium, Bibliotheca Vaticana Prefectum., 585

page.notes: The first line is a fragment: it continues an entry from the previous page, and its opening words are not on this page. The printed ornament below the list is a decorative printer's device, not text, and is not transcribed. Faint marks in the middle and lower part of the page are show-through from the other side and are left out. "Prefectum" is printed with a superscript or tail mark after the word that I read as a comma; the form is doubtful. "Ecchellensis" and "Ecclesijs" are transcribed as printed. The 's' long s is written as plain s throughout.
